Package com.hkust.marketplace.services

Class MyDealsService

java.lang.Object
com.hkust.marketplace.services.MyDealsService
public class MyDealsService extends Object
UC7 Manage My Deals, for the Buyer (Task 1.6): the buyer's current and completed deals, marking a purchase or claim complete, and returning a borrowed item before its due date. It also finds the automatic returns whose seller the buyer has not reviewed yet (client answer #3).

Design (Lecture 15). This is the use case's control class. The boundary is the buyer's My Deals screen (controllers.buyer.MyDealsView), which also asks the buyer to confirm (steps 4-5; A3) before calling markComplete(java.lang.String) or returnItem(java.lang.String). The entities are Offer, Listing and the store. What a completed or returned deal does to the listing and whom it notifies is shared with the borrowing-deadline timer, so it lives in DealRules; this class adds the buyer's own rules in front of it.

Defensive programming (Lecture 10). A deal is named by its id, which is untrusted: each method checks that the deal exists and is the logged-in buyer's, has the right type, and is in the one state that allows the action (Special Requirement 1). The buttons on the screen follow Deal.canBeMarkedComplete() and Deal.canBeReturned(), but the same rules are checked again here, for a screen that is out of date or bypassed.

  • Method Details

    • getMyDeals

      public List<Deal> getMyDeals()
      The logged-in buyer's deals: the current ones (pending, countered, or accepted and not yet completed), the most recently made first, followed by the completed ones, the most recently completed first. Declined deals are neither, so they are not listed; they stay in the chat history.
      Returns:
      the deals; empty if the buyer has none (A1)

    • markComplete

      public Deal markComplete(String offerId)
      Marks the buyer's accepted price offer or claim complete, after the buyer confirmed: the deal gets today as its completion date, the listing becomes Sold or Given, and the seller is notified. The screen then prompts the buyer to rate the seller (step 9).
      Returns:
      the deal as it is now, completed
      Throws:
      ServiceException - if the deal is not the buyer's, is a borrow request (which is completed by returning the item), is not accepted, or is already completed

    • returnItem

      public Deal returnItem(String offerId)
      Returns the item of the buyer's accepted borrow request before its due date, after the buyer confirmed: the deal gets today as its completion date, the listing becomes Live again unless the admin removed it meanwhile, and the seller is notified.
      Returns:
      the deal as it is now, completed
      Throws:
      ServiceException - if the deal is not the buyer's, is not a borrow request, is not accepted, was already returned, or its due date has come (Special Requirement 3)

    • getAutoReturnedDealsToReview

      public List<Deal> getAutoReturnedDealsToReview()
      The logged-in buyer's borrowed items that were returned automatically (UC12) and whose seller the buyer has not reviewed yet, the most recently returned first. The buyer's dashboard asks the buyer to rate the seller of each one the timer returns while the buyer is using the app (client answer #3, UC10 step 1); for one returned while the buyer was away, the auto-return notification says so instead.
